assets/vo/s01-fb1fb486.mp3: Here's how the Claude Code team does code review, in under sixty seconds.
assets/vo/s02-649e6bbd.mp3: With agents writing code, Anthropic's daily changes jumped from twenty-five hundred to over thirty thousand.
assets/vo/s02-0884c620.mp3: Nobody can read all that, so they stack layers, not one gate.
assets/vo/s03-c161c070.mp3: Say you ask Claude to fix a bug. Let's follow the fix through each layer.
assets/vo/s04-e750017a.mp3: Layer one, on your machine: Claude runs the tests and shows the output.
assets/vo/s04-00230a79.mp3: Then a second Claude, with fresh eyes, rereads the change.
assets/vo/s05-c44e999c.mp3: Layer two: the fix goes up for review, and several agents hunt for bugs at once.
assets/vo/s05-ec443221.mp3: Another group votes on each finding, and it's only posted if enough agree it's real.
assets/vo/s06-f720e7cb.mp3: Layer three: security review and checks. Any open finding blocks the merge.
assets/vo/s07-f98951fa.mp3: Layer four: people, scaled by risk. Docs need no approver, normal changes one, the riskiest two.
assets/vo/s08-03f266c0.mp3: In three months, merged changes more than doubled, and the rollback rate fell over forty percent.
assets/vo/s08-f809d3c6.mp3: The AI never approves. It only posts findings.
assets/vo/s04-4eb61f9a.mp3: Layer one, on your machine: Claude runs the tests, then a second Claude, with fresh eyes, rereads the change.
assets/vo/s05-25930bf3.mp3: Layer two, in review: several agents hunt for bugs at once.
